description: 放課後の高校体育館で、バスケットボール部の3人の生徒が自主練習をしている。中央では男子生徒がジャンプシュートを打っており、ボールはゴールへ向かって飛んでいる。左側の女子生徒はカラーコーンの間をジグザグにドリブルしながらボールコントロールの練習をしている。右側の男子生徒はリバウンド練習のためゴール下で構えながら、壁のホワイトボードに書かれた練習メニューも確認している。体育館にはバスケットゴール、ボールラック、カラーコーン、水筒、タオル、スポーツバッグ、ストップウォッチなどがあり、本格的な部活動の雰囲気が伝わる。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three Japanese high school students practicing with their basketball club inside a bright school gymnasium after school. Do not include any additional visible people. The atmosphere should be energetic, disciplined, athletic, cooperative, and positive. All three students should wear matching school basketball practice uniforms and indoor basketball shoes. In the center foreground, a teenage boy is performing a jump shot. He is clearly airborne with both arms extended upward after releasing the basketball, and the ball is visibly traveling in a natural arc toward the basketball hoop. On the left side, a teenage girl is practicing ball-handling by dribbling a second basketball in a clear zigzag course through five colorful training cones. Her body should be slightly lowered in an athletic stance, her eyes looking forward, and one hand controlling the ball. On the right side, another teenage boy is standing underneath and slightly beside the basket in a ready position for a rebound drill, with his knees bent and both hands raised. He is watching the ball that the central player has just shot. Make the three roles visually clear: one player taking a jump shot, one player practicing dribbling through cones, and one player preparing to collect the rebound. Include exactly two basketballs in active use: one flying toward the hoop and one being dribbled. Additional basketballs may be neatly stored on a ball rack in the background. Include one basketball hoop with backboard and net, court lines, five training cones, a ball rack, three reusable water bottles, towels, sports bags, a stopwatch resting on a bench, and a small whiteboard showing a simple practice plan with nonessential icons such as shooting, dribbling, passing, and conditioning. Large gym windows should show warm late-afternoon sunlight entering the gym. Add polished wooden flooring with realistic reflections and clear court markings. The scene must look like organized Japanese high school club practice rather than a professional match. Exactly three visible people. No coach, no spectators, no additional players, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters, and no important readable text. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, realistic proportions, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The three students are practicing with their basketball club after school.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は放課後にバスケットボール部で練習しています。

sentences.text: The central player is taking a jump shot toward the basket.
sentences.ja: 中央の選手がゴールに向かってジャンプシュートを打っています。

sentences.text: The basketball is flying through the air toward the hoop.
sentences.ja: バスケットボールがゴールに向かって飛んでいます。

sentences.text: The girl is dribbling through several cones to improve her ball control.
sentences.ja: 女子生徒はボールコントロールを向上させるため、複数のコーンの間をドリブルしています。

sentences.text: She looks focused while moving through the course.
sentences.ja: 彼女はコースを進みながら集中しているようです。

sentences.text: The other boy is preparing to catch the rebound.
sentences.ja: もう一人の男子生徒はリバウンドを取る準備をしています。

sentences.text: He is watching the ball carefully with both hands raised.
sentences.ja: 彼は両手を上げてボールを注意深く見ています。

sentences.text: The training equipment suggests that they are working on several different basketball skills.
sentences.ja: 練習用具から、3人がさまざまなバスケットボール技術を練習していることが分かります。

sentences.text: The three club members are participating in a structured basketball practice designed to refine different individual techniques.
sentences.grammar: 過去分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 3人の部員は、それぞれ異なる個人技術を磨くための計画的なバスケットボール練習に取り組んでいます。

sentences.text: The central player is executing a jump shot while maintaining a balanced shooting posture.
sentences.ja: 中央の選手はバランスの取れたシュート姿勢を保ちながらジャンプシュートを打っています。

sentences.text: The trajectory of the ball suggests that he is concentrating on both accuracy and shooting technique.
sentences.grammar: suggest that / both A and B
sentences.ja: ボールの軌道から、彼がシュートの正確性と技術の両方に集中していることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The female player is maneuvering through a series of cones in order to develop greater agility and ball-handling control.
sentences.ja: 女子選手は敏捷性とボールコントロールを高めるため、一連のコーンの間をドリブルしています。

sentences.text: Her lowered stance and forward gaze indicate that she is concentrating on maintaining control while moving quickly.
sentences.ja: 低い姿勢と前方を見る視線から、素早く動きながらボールをコントロールすることに集中していると分かります。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the third player is anticipating the rebound and maintaining a ready stance beneath the basket.
sentences.ja: その一方で、3人目の選手はゴール下で準備姿勢を取りながらリバウンドを予測しています。

sentences.text: His raised hands and bent knees suggest that he is prepared to retrieve the ball immediately after the shot.
sentences.ja: 上げた両手と曲げた膝から、シュート後すぐにボールを回収する準備ができていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The cones, ball rack, stopwatch, and practice board indicate a disciplined training routine rather than an informal game.
sentences.ja: コーン、ボールラック、ストップウォッチ、練習ボードから、単なる遊びではなく規律ある練習であることが分かります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how school club activities can develop athletic ability, concentration, persistence, and teamwork through repeated practice.
sentences.ja: この場面は、学校の部活動が反復練習を通して運動能力、集中力、粘り強さ、チームワークを育てることを示しています。
